watches.name: The Whale Shark - 32mm
watches.description: The Whale Shark is the largest fish in the ocean, and one of its most graceful. Despite its immense size, this gentle giant moves with quiet elegance through warm tropical waters, filter-feeding on plankton and small fish. It's the Iconic skin pattern that truly sets it apart, a galaxy of white spots and stripes scattered across a deep grey-blue canvas, as unique as a fingerprint. Often described as nature’s moving artwork, The Whale Shark is a living mystery. Found along the coasts of Australia, especially Ningaloo Reef, The Whale Shark has become a symbol of oceanic wonder, biodiversity, and balance, its transition to become a part of our wildlife collection is seamless. The dial of The Whale Shark watch is a breathtaking tribute to the ocean’s most majestic giant. It features a deep gradient of oceanic blue, darkening as it moves outward from the center, echoing the depth and mystery of open water. Across the dial, a constellation of soft white dots and flowing lines creates a beautiful illustration of The Whale Shark’s iconic pattern - each mark carefully placed to evoke both movement and awe.

watches.name: Great Barrier Reef - Automatic 40.5mm
watches.description: The Great Barrier Reef — A Natural Wonder, Captured on Your Wrist. Inspired by the colour, beauty and marine life of Australia’s Great Barrier Reef, this limited edition Blessington collection brings an extraordinary underwater world into an everyday timepiece. A richly detailed ocean-blue dial captures the spirit of the reef, with fish woven into the underwater scene. Look closer, and there’s more to discover. Once charged by light, the luminous fish glow in the dark , bringing a new dimension to the dial as daylight fades. Every watch is individually serial numbered. Each version has its own limited production run, with your watch carrying a number within that edition: Men’s Quartz: Numbered 1–500 — limited to 500 watches. Women’s Quartz: Numbered 1–500 — limited to 500 watches. Men’s Automatic: Numbered 1–100 — limited to just 100 watches. Your individual number marks your watch’s place in the collection, making it a personal keepsake, a meaningful gift or a distinctive addition to your watch collection. Crafted with 316L stainless steel and sapphire crystal , the Great Barrier Reef pairs its expressive dial with enduring materials. From its intricate daytime details to its luminous character after dark, this is a watch made to be worn, admired and remembered. Bring the reef to your wrist. Own your number.

watches.name: Alpine Frost
watches.description: The Snowy Monaro Anniversary Series is a return to the very beginning of Blessington Watches. Inspired by the alpine ranges open landscapes and changing colours of the Snowy Monaro region the original series helped establish what Blessington would become. A watch brand built around meaningful Australian stories and limited edition designs. Five years later the Snowy Monaro returns in four anniversary editions. Every design captures a different character of the region while sharing the same bold chronograph layout and original 42mm proportions. At its heart is the Japanese Seiko VD53 quartz chronograph movement featuring hacking seconds a 60-minute chronograph 24-hour display and date function. Each watch also offers 20 ATM water resistance and a detailed case back depicting the Snowy Mountains of New South Wales. Only 500 watches will be produced across the entire series. Three editions are limited to 100 pieces each while the black edition is limited to 200. This is not simply another release. It is a piece of Blessington history created to celebrate the collection that helped begin our story and the people who have supported us throughout the past five years. Launching 27 August at 7:30 PM AEST. Once sold out the Snowy Monaro Anniversary Series will never be produced again.

watches.name: The Whale Shark - Tungsten 42mm
watches.description: THE TUNGSTEN WHALE SHARK Gentle Giant. Mastered in Steel. The Whale Shark is the largest fish in the ocean, and one of its most graceful. Despite its immense size, this gentle giant moves with calm confidence through warm tropical waters, filter feeding effortlessly as it glides beneath the surface. Powerful yet peaceful, it is a rare balance of scale, elegance, and restraint. Nature’s Living Artwork. What truly sets the Whale Shark apart is its iconic skin pattern. A galaxy of white spots and flowing stripes scattered across a deep grey blue canvas, each pattern entirely unique, much like a fingerprint. Found along Australia’s coastline, most famously at Ningaloo Reef , the Whale Shark has become a symbol of oceanic wonder, biodiversity, and balance. Its place in our Wildlife Collection feels instinctive. Elevated to Tungsten. The Tungsten Whale Shark represents the most refined version of this design we have ever produced. Built as part of our 200 meter diver collection , it is engineered for strength, depth, and endurance, while maintaining a calm, composed presence on the wrist. This is scale and capability without aggression, just like the animal itself. A Dial Inspired by the Deep. The dial is a breathtaking tribute to the ocean’s most majestic giant. A deep oceanic blue gradient radiates from the centre, darkening as it moves outward, echoing the mystery and depth of open water. Across the surface, a constellation of soft white dots and flowing lines recreates the Whale Shark’s unmistakable pattern, each mark carefully placed to evoke movement, scale, and awe. Calm Power. Endless Depth. Every detail is deliberate. Nothing rushed. Nothing excessive. The design invites closer inspection, rewarding patience and attention, much like an encounter with the Whale Shark itself. Japanese Super Luminescence. Equipped with Japanese super lume , the dial comes alive in low light. The luminous elements glow intensely and last deep into the night, reflecting the Whale Shark’s ghost like presence as it moves through dark waters. Built in Its Image. This is not a watch designed to dominate through force, but through presence. Measured. Confident. Timeless. The Tungsten Whale Shark is a celebration of nature at its most awe inspiring and stands proudly as one of the finest watches we have ever created at Blessington .

Every detail is deliberate. Nothing rushed. Nothing excessive. The design invites closer inspection, rewarding patience and attention, much like an encounter with the Whale Shark itself.
Equipped with Japanese super lume , the dial comes alive in low light. The luminous elements glow intensely and last deep into the night, reflecting the Whale Shark’s ghost like presence as it moves through dark waters.
This is not a watch designed to dominate through force, but through presence. Measured. Confident. Timeless.

Paired with glowing details and a beautifully balanced design Rose Sky is made for those who want something feminine radiant and unforgettable.

Its purple finish offers a bold and elegant statement while the beautiful lume adds another layer of magic after dark. Refined and distinctive Violet Dusk is a stunning dress watch that feels both modern and unforgettable.

watches.name: The Red Belly - Tungsten 42mm
watches.description: THE TUNGSTEN RED BELLY Warning in Motion. Precision in Steel. Sleek, striking, and unmistakably Australian, the Red Belly Black Snake is one of the country’s most iconic reptiles. Native to eastern Australia, it moves effortlessly through forests, swamps, and creek beds with calm confidence. Its deep, glossy black upper scales absorb the light, while its vivid crimson belly delivers a bold contrast that signals both beauty and danger. Quiet Power. Controlled Presence. Despite its intimidating appearance, the Red Belly is naturally reserved. It prefers avoidance over confrontation, slipping away unnoticed when given the chance. But when threatened, it flattens its body and flares its colours in a powerful display. A reminder that restraint and warning often carry more authority than aggression. This same philosophy defines the Tungsten Red Belly . Built Stronger Than Ever. The Tungsten Red Belly represents the highest level of craftsmanship we have ever applied to this design. Built as part of our 200 meter diver collection , it is engineered for durability, pressure, and long term wear. Its presence on the wrist is bold without being loud, confident without needing explanation. A Dial That Commands Attention. The dial is a high contrast tribute to the Red Belly’s unmistakable colouring. At its core, a rich crimson gradient radiates outward, fading into deep black at the edges. This mirrors the snake’s vivid underbelly and obsidian upper scales. A sharp, scale inspired texture overlays the dial, creating depth and dimension, as if the snake’s skin itself has been preserved beneath the crystal. Danger Refined. Every detail is deliberate. Strong contrasts. Clean lines. A balance between elegance and warning. The design captures the Red Belly’s cool composure and latent power in a form built to endure. Japanese Super Luminescence. The Tungsten Red Belly features Japanese super lume , producing a bright, long lasting glow in darkness. The lume highlights key elements of the dial, ensuring clarity while amplifying the contrast and danger inherent in the design. Built in Its Image. This is not just a visual reference. It is a timepiece shaped by the character of the animal itself. Calm. Capable. Unmistakably powerful. The Tungsten Red Belly stands as one of the boldest expressions in our diver collection and is, without question, one of the finest watches we have ever made at Blessington

Every detail is deliberate. Strong contrasts. Clean lines. A balance between elegance and warning. The design captures the Red Belly’s cool composure and latent power in a form built to endure.

watches.name: The Migaloo - Tungsten 42mm
watches.description: THE TUNGSTEN MIGALOO Rare by Nature. Luminous by Design. Migaloo , the world famous albino humpback whale, is one of the rarest creatures ever documented in the wild. Sighted along Australia’s east coast, Migaloo is a symbol of rarity, mystery, and quiet power. Massive in scale yet gentle in movement, this once in a lifetime animal moves through the ocean with a presence that feels almost unreal. A Once in a Lifetime Phenomenon. Unlike any other whale on earth, Migaloo’s striking white form cuts through deep blue water like light itself. Calm, deliberate, and awe inspiring, Migaloo represents balance, endurance, and the extraordinary beauty that exists when nature breaks its own rules. That sense of rarity and reverence is at the heart of the Tungsten Migaloo . Elevated to Our Highest Standard. The Tungsten Migaloo is part of our 200 meter diver collection and represents the most refined execution of this design we have ever produced. Built for depth, durability, and long term wear, it carries a quiet authority on the wrist, powerful without needing to shout. A Dial Born from Light and Water. The dial is a clean, luminous tribute to Migaloo’s unmistakable presence. Soft whites and subtle gradients reflect the whale’s pale form as it moves through dark ocean depths. The texture and detailing are intentionally restrained, allowing light to play across the surface, creating depth, movement, and contrast without excess. Japanese Super Luminescence. This model is fitted with Japanese super lume , delivering an exceptionally bright and long lasting glow. In low light or underwater conditions, the dial comes alive, mirroring Migaloo’s ghost like appearance as it emerges from the darkness. The lume is bold, crisp, and purposeful, reinforcing the idea of light cutting through the deep. Quiet Power. Rare Presence. Every detail is considered. Nothing is accidental. The Tungsten Migaloo is designed to feel calm, balanced, and enduring, just like the animal that inspired it. Built in Its Image. This is not a watch made to follow trends. It is a tribute to something truly rare. The Tungsten Migaloo stands as one of the most unique pieces in our diver collection and, without question, one of the finest watches we have ever made at Blessington .

The Tungsten Migaloo is part of our 200 meter diver collection and represents the most refined execution of this design we have ever produced. Built for depth, durability, and long term wear, it carries a quiet authority on the wrist, powerful without needing to shout.

watches.name: The Eastern Brown - Tungsten 42mm
watches.description: THE TUNGSTEN EASTERN BROWN Deadly Precision. Absolute Control. The Eastern Brown Snake is Australia’s most lethal serpent and one of the most dangerous snakes on earth. Silent, calculated, and devastatingly precise, it embodies a rare balance of elegance and danger. With a natural brown sheen that blends seamlessly into its surroundings, the Eastern Brown waits motionless, poised to strike with speed and accuracy that leaves no margin for error. Australia’s Apex Serpent. Among Australia’s vast and diverse snake species, the Eastern Brown stands alone at the top. Not through aggression, but through efficiency. Its presence is understated, its threat absolute. This philosophy of quiet dominance defines the Tungsten Eastern Brown , a timepiece designed to reflect power without excess. Elevated to Tungsten. Built as part of our 200 meter diver collection , the Tungsten Eastern Brown is the most refined and capable version of this design we have ever produced. Engineered for pressure, durability, and long term wear, it delivers confidence through construction, not noise. A Dial Forged in Texture and Tone. The dial is a bold tribute to the Eastern Brown’s unmistakable scales. A textured surface mimics the snake’s skin, creating depth and movement beneath the crystal. Rich brown tones shift subtly with the light, echoing the reptile’s natural sheen and its ability to disappear into the environment until the moment it strikes. Japanese Super Luminescence. Fitted with Japanese super lume , the Eastern Brown delivers an intense, long lasting glow in low light and underwater conditions. The luminous elements cut through darkness with clarity and purpose, reinforcing legibility while reflecting the snake’s lethal accuracy in the shadows. Refined Danger. Unmistakable Authority. Every detail is deliberate. Balanced. Controlled. This is a watch that does not seek attention, yet commands it completely. Built in Its Image. Calm. Precise. Unforgiving. The Tungsten Eastern Brown stands as one of the most powerful expressions in our Wildlife Collection and, without question, one of the finest watches we have ever made at Blessington .

Built as part of our 200 meter diver collection , the Tungsten Eastern Brown is the most refined and capable version of this design we have ever produced. Engineered for pressure, durability, and long term wear, it delivers confidence through construction, not noise.
Fitted with Japanese super lume , the Eastern Brown delivers an intense, long lasting glow in low light and underwater conditions. The luminous elements cut through darkness with clarity and purpose, reinforcing legibility while reflecting the snake’s lethal accuracy in the shadows.
Every detail is deliberate. Balanced. Controlled. This is a watch that does not seek attention, yet commands it completely.

watches.name: The Green Tree - Tungsten 42mm
watches.description: THE TUNGSTEN GREEN TREE PYTHON Stillness Perfected. Precision Uncoiled. Coiled like living sculpture high within the Daintree rainforest canopy, the Green Tree Python is one of Australia’s most visually striking reptiles. Found in the tropical forests of northern Queensland, it is instantly recognisable by its electric green scales, often accented with flashes of yellow. Vivid yet controlled, its beauty lies not in movement, but in stillness. Master of Patience. Apex Precision. The Green Tree Python spends much of its life suspended motionless in its signature saddle position, perfectly camouflaged among leaves and moss. When it strikes, it does so with slow, calculated precision. That same philosophy defines the Tungsten Green Tree Python , a timepiece designed with restraint, balance, and absolute control. Elevated to Tungsten. As part of our 200 meter diver collection , the Tungsten Green Tree Python represents the most refined execution of this design we have ever produced. Built for durability, pressure, and long term wear, it delivers strength without aggression and presence without noise. A Dial Alive with Depth. The dial is a bold homage to the python’s hypnotic form. A vibrant lime green gradient radiates from the centre, darkening toward the edges, creating depth and contrast. watches.name: The Rainbow Lorikeet - Steel 32mm
watches.description: Loud, vibrant, and full of character, The Rainbow Lorikeet is the life of the treetops and the inspiration behind one of the most colourful dials we've ever created. Common across much of coastal Australia but anything but ordinary, these birds are known for their playful energy, piercing calls, and a palette that looks like it was painted by hand. The dial of The Rainbow Lorikeet bursts with colour. Waves of red, blue, yellow, green, and orange twist and turn across the face in a pattern inspired by the bird’s feathers in full flight. Each colour pops with a life of its own, echoing the chaos and charm of lorikeets darting through backyards, balconies, and bushland alike. This piece isn’t just a watch. It’s a celebration of joy, movement, and colour - the kind only nature (and a lorikeet) can deliver.

watches.name: The Whale Shark - Steel 32mm
watches.description: The Whale Shark is the largest fish in the ocean, and one of its most graceful. Despite its immense size, this gentle giant moves with quiet elegance through warm tropical waters, filter-feeding on plankton and small fish. It's the Iconic skin pattern that truly sets it apart, a galaxy of white spots and stripes scattered across a deep grey-blue canvas, as unique as a fingerprint. Often described as nature’s moving artwork, The Whale Shark is a living mystery. Found along the coasts of Australia, especially Ningaloo Reef, The Whale Shark has become a symbol of oceanic wonder, biodiversity, and balance, its transition to become a part of our wildlife collection is seamless. The dial of The Whale Shark watch is a breathtaking tribute to the ocean’s most majestic giant. It features a deep gradient of oceanic blue, darkening as it moves outward from the center, echoing the depth and mystery of open water. Across the dial, a constellation of soft white dots and flowing lines creates a beautiful illustration of The Whale Shark’s iconic pattern - each mark carefully placed to evoke both movement and awe.

watches.name: The Corroboree Frog - Steel 32mm
watches.description: Striking, rare, and uniquely Australian, The Corroboree Frog is a tribute to one of our most visually iconic and endangered native species. Found only in the alpine regions of southeastern Australia, this tiny frog is famous for its vivid yellow-and-black skin, a natural warning that beauty sometimes comes with a dose of danger. The dial captures that same high-contrast intensity, featuring a bold, layered pattern of yellow and black markings that echo the frog’s unmistakable coloration. Each line twists with organic unpredictability, just like the frog’s natural camouflage. The Corroboree Frog is a conversation starter, a show of support for Australia’s rarest, and a symbol of just how much character can come in a small package.
